price_factors.heading: What shapes your training price
price_factors.description: Six things decide what your organization pays for instructor-led training with Edstellar.

items.title: Team size
items.text: More trainees use more licenses. Bigger packages save up to 20%.

items.title: Program length
items.text: Half-day, full-day or multi-day programs use licenses differently.

items.title: Delivery mode
items.text: Virtual instructor-led is the package price. Onsite at your location is +30%.

items.title: Program type
items.text: Specialist technical and compliance programs need niche trainers, which can vary the price.

items.title: Customisation
items.text: Programs built around your tools, cases and processes take extra design time.

items.title: Certification & labs
items.text: Exam fees and hands-on lab environments are billed separately.

items.title: One-off training
items.text: No package commitment. Start with a paid trial session.

items.title: Starter / Growth
items.text: Fixed licenses for a few teams, with 6–9 months to use them.

items.title: Enterprise
items.text: 800 licenses across departments and locations, with up to 20% savings.

items.title: Custom
items.text: Per-employee pricing with unlimited training sessions.

items.question: What is included in the Corporate Training Packages?
items.answer: Training packages include trainer fee, course material, handouts etc. Some customized and premium training programs and onsite training in remote locations are not part of the package and can incur additional charges.

items.question: How much do corporate training packages cost?
items.answer: Please contact us to know more about the pricing structure for each corporate training package. Contact us by filling the form or writing an email to us at contact@edstellar.com

items.question: What are the charges of onsite training?
items.answer: Onsite training comes at an additional cost that covers the trainer's travel and accommodation expenses. Please get in touch with us for the pricing options.

items.question: Can I customize a training package to suit my organization's specific needs?
items.answer: The custom package is specially designed for organizations with specific training needs. Contact us to discuss your training requirements and we will help you with more information about our packages.

items.question: How can I purchase a corporate training package for my organization?
items.answer: Please fill the form or write to us at contact@edstellar.com and our consultant will support you in purchasing a corporate training package that meets your needs.

items.question: What is the role of the Dedicated Learning Services Manager mentioned in the packages?
items.answer: The dedicated learning services manager will be your single point of contact who will support you and your teams throughout the engagement.

items.question: What additional services can we request as part of our training package?
items.answer: Coaching, Mentoring, Training Needs Analysis, Content Development for training, and training at an external venue are offered as additional services with an additional cost.

items.question: What is not included in the corporate training rates?
items.answer: Certification/exam fees, post-training support, labs, facilities, and catering services for onsite training are not included in the corporate training pricing and will be billed separately.

items.question: I have discrete training requirements. Can I take training without opting for any package?
items.answer: Absolutely! We provide training options for individual employees or small groups without requiring you to commit to any of our packages. Additionally, you can explore our paid trial session to experience our training.

items.question: How much does corporate training cost per employee?
items.answer: Each employee uses one license per 8-hour training day. The Custom package is priced per employee, with unlimited sessions.

items.question: Is pricing per day or per person?
items.answer: Both. Licenses count each trainee for each training day, so you pay only for training delivered.

items.question: How much extra is onsite training?
items.answer: 30% more than virtual. This covers the trainer’s travel and accommodation. Venue and catering are not included.

items.question: Are there hidden costs?
items.answer: No. Certification, labs, post-training support, venue and catering are listed separately before you sign.
